glyph_origin: Originally 臱. Phono-semantic compound (形聲): semantic 辶 (= 辵) (“walking; movement”) + phonetic 臱. The semantic component 辵 (now 辶) was added during bronze inscriptions.
s_page_origin: Simplified from 邊 (臱 → 力). Officially adopted as the simplified form of 邊 in the Chinese Character Simplification Scheme (漢字簡化方案) in 1956.
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 邊; s_page_origin explains the simplified 边.
